context: Data on maternal and perinatal risk factors were collected from daily neonatal notes. RESULTS: 31 babies (7.3%, CI 5.0–10.2) developed any ROP, 13 of whom (41.9%, CI 24.5–60.9) required treatment. ROP was seen in six neonates with GA > 30 weeks and BW > 1500 g, one of whom required treatment.
target: In univariate analysis the following were associated with any ROP: increasing number of days on supplemental oxygen (OR 2.1, CI 1.5–3.0, P < 0.001), low GA (OR 3.4, CI 1.8–6.4, P < 0.001), low BW (OR 2.3, CI 1.5–3.4, P < 0.001), at least one episode of hyperglycaemia ≥ 150 mg/dl (OR 6.6, CI 2.0–21.5, P < 0.001), blood transfusion (OR 3.5, CI 1.6–7.4, P < 0.001) or sepsis (OR 3.2, CI 1.2–8.6, P = 0.01).
